svg.data-psu-redundancy: 1+1 fixed dual feed, 120 W per supply (not field-replaceable)
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO with optional holdover; ITU-T SyncE; IEEE 1588v2 default, G.8265.1, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, SMPTE ST 2059-2 (extra licence), T-BC/OC, T-TC; Class C accuracy. NOS integration is required to activate the timing features
svg.data-timing-interfaces: 1PPS in/out on SMB, 10MHz in/out on SMB, ToD in/out on RJ45 - one connector per function (datasheet Timing Interfaces)
svg.data-timing-cables: 50 ohm SMB coaxial with 10-32UNF-2A for 1PPS and 10MHz; shielded RJ45 for ToD (datasheet Compatible Timing Cable Types)
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A; ICES-003, Class A; EN 55032, Class A; EN 55035; EN 300 386; VCCI CISPR 32, Class A; SANS 2332, Class A; SANS 2335

g.data-description: HIG section 8 Front Panel LED table, SYNC row - Off (timing synchronization disabled or free-run), Solid Green (timing core, 1588 and SyncE, synchronized to an external source), Blinking Green (synchronized in SyncE mode), Solid Yellow (acquiring state or holdover), Blinking Yellow (synchronization fail). Every row but Solid Yellow is annotated: need NOS to activate this feature
g.title: led-sync

g.data-description: HIG section 8 Front Panel LED table, STAT row - Off (x86 and BMC initializing or not powered), Solid Green (boot complete), Blinking Green (system is booting)
g.title: led-stat

g.data-description: HIG section 8 Front Panel LED table, PSU row - Off (reserved), Solid Green (both PSU1 and PSU2 power good), Solid Yellow (PSU1 good, PSU2 not good), Blinking Yellow (PSU1 not good, PSU2 good). The two yellows name DIFFERENT feeds, which is the whole information content of this lamp and is lost by a colour-only model
g.title: led-psu

g.data-description: HIG section 8 Front Panel LED table, PWR row - Off (x86 and BMC initializing or not powered), Solid Green (system power good and CPU board power good), Blinking Green (system power fail, CPU board power good), Solid Yellow (system power good, CPU board power fail), Blinking Yellow (both fail)
g.title: led-pwr

g.data-description: led-mgmt-left: HIG section 8 Management port LED table, Left LED - Off (1G no link), Solid Green (1G link-up), Blinking Green (1G TX/RX activity); led-mgmt-right: HIG section 8 Management port LED table, Right LED - Off (no link), Solid Amber (10M/100M link-up), Blinking Amber (10M/100M TX/RX activity). The two lamps do not share a vocabulary, so they are declared separately
g.title: mgmt
